name: slack-ask-user-token
label: Paste the token
description: The User OAuth Token your Slack app shows: it acts as you. Verified against Slack before it is sent.

exe_data.detail: Right after **Create and Install**, Slack shows **Your app credentials**: copy the *User OAuth Token* (`xoxp-…`). Later it is under {{manifest.name}} → **OAuth & Permissions**. It acts as you in Slack.
